I've saved countless hours of repetitive SQL coding by mastering dbt macros - and I'm excited to share my top learnings with you.

As a data engineer, I've worked on numerous projects that involve complex SQL transformations. 
One challenge I faced was writing and maintaining identical SQL code across multiple models. 
That's when I discovered dbt macros.

I started using dbt's `macro` function to create reusable SQL components. 
For instance, I created a macro for generating surrogate keys: 
`{% macro generate_surrogate_key(column_name) %}{{ column_name }}_sk{% endmacro %}`. 
This macro can be easily invoked in any model using `{{ generate_surrogate_key('id') }}`.

By leveraging dbt macros, I've reduced code duplication and made my SQL code more maintainable. 
I've also created a library of reusable macros for common tasks, such as data validation and data masking.

Have you used dbt macros in your analytics engineering projects? What are some of your favorite use cases?
